author: Dandrista
title: Looking for 2D anime artist for Jinx/Pokémon themed art
content: LONG THREAD ALERT! I am looking for a 2D artist (or artists) specializing in the anime style, with experience drawing Jinx and Pokémon! If you are interested, please drop your VGen link! (DMs will be blocked, unless you have worked with me previously.) #vgen #VgenComm I want to share more precise details about what I’m looking for... (multiple PFPs, banner, panels, 8 illustrations involving Jinx, Pokémon, and other characters). The budget is $120–$150 for the whole project, though it’s open to negotiation. Contact: reply with VGen or DM with specific phrase. Email: melerod72@gmail.com

author: 貂矢わんや🦫🏹@新人Vtuber😎
title: Looking for long-term illustrator for monthly commissions
content: 今、イラストレーターさんを探しているよ。 つなぐでサブスクで受けて頂ける方で、月〜1.5万くらいまででテーマだけお渡ししてお任せで毎月描いて下さる方… メロや色気が得意で、長期でお願いするものだから、すぐではなくとも僕(被写体)に思い入れを持ってくれるひとだと特に嬉しいなぁ Contact: via Tsunagu or reply. Budget ~10,000-15,000 JPY/month for ongoing themed illustrations.
